servinfosub.title: Moving Part

item.ptxt: Visually check compressor, turbine and waste gate valve for deformation and damage.
Wobble shaft with finger and check that compressor blades do not touch the housing.
Blow compressed air on compressor and check the shaft for smooth rotation.

servinfosub.ptxt: If any abnormality is found replace turbocharger.

servinfosub.title: Distortion of Gasket Surface
servinfosub.ptxt: Using straightedge and feeler gauge, check turbocharger surface for distortion.
If distortion exceeds the limit, repair the surface.
If repair is not possible, replace turbocharger.
